sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We appreciate your openness and the proposal for a 24-month contract, which provides valuable planning security for our foundry.
In return for this longer commitment, we are prepared to adjust our price to €51.30 per unit.
We value our long-standing partnership and believe this reflects a fair step forward.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €50.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
Thank you for your continued openness and your question regarding how we might find further room on the price.
As you offered to discuss terms that help us, we propose postponing the effective date to 1 February 2027.
In exchange for this later start date, we are able to make a more significant step and offer a price of €50.40 per unit.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 February 2027: €50.40 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €49.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
Thank you for your revised offer and your continued effort to reach an agreement.
We are prepared to make a further step to €49.40 per unit for the 24-month contract starting 1 December 2026.
As previously stated, if you require more flexibility on the price, we would need to postpone the effective date.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
